about: Photographs and loops for Nosca's website, chosen as one story and brought to one grade beside the business card. Every file is listed three ways: `photos` (one entry a picture, with its three widths), `loops` (one entry a clip, with its poster) and `files` (every file by name).
notes: focal is the point to keep in view when a picture is cropped, as fractions of its width and height from the top left; focus is the same as a CSS object-position.
headline says where words can sit and in which colour (white, or the ink).
dominant is the colour to paint behind a picture while it loads.
use is a suggestion: hero (a full-bleed opening), chapter (a full-width picture inside a page), inline (beside or between text), loop (video).
Nobody shown is a Nosca coach, player or customer, and nothing on the page may say or imply so; no picture shows a face to the camera.
Legible brand marks were painted out of six pictures (CREDITS.md says which); nothing else in any picture was altered beyond the crop and the grade.
A loop is muted H.264 with a keyframe every 12 frames, so its currentTime can be scrubbed by the scroll as well as played.
grade: One grade for all: saturation lowered to about four fifths with a ceiling on the hottest colours, a gentle S-curve with lifted blacks and held whites, a touch of warmth, shadows leaning to the card's bottle green and highlights to cream. The loops take the same grade as a 3D LUT.
